restaurant_name: Geriatric Medical Center, Chiang Mai University
text:
I brought my father here for laparoscopic colon surgery. We were able to use our direct billing insurance. The attending physicians were a team of professors from Suan Dok Hospital.

While staying in the ward on the 5th floor, the staff—nurses, assistants, cleaning staff, and food service staff—provided excellent care. They were always smiling. Thank you very much.

The only downside is that parking might be difficult during the day. Overall, I was very impressed with this place.

text: I arrived at 6 am, but the staff forgot to call my number. I finally saw the doctor almost at noon, and had to wait until the afternoon to get my medication. The system needs improvement.

restaurant_name: Geriatric Medical Center, Chiang Mai University
text:
Today I brought my father for a scheduled check-up for a brain condition. We had a blood test at 7:00 AM and an appointment with the doctor at 11:30 AM.
We arrived before the appointment. The nurse took his blood pressure, and I could still see the doctor sitting in the examination room. We waited for about half an hour. I tried asking the nurse at the counter, and they said the doctor had left and would return in the afternoon. How can you treat an elderly person like this? We had to wait until after noon before we could go home for lunch. What kind of doctor are you? Where did you graduate from? Is this the Chiang Mai University Senior Care Center?

restaurant_name: Geriatric Medical Center, Chiang Mai University
text:
The security guard at the front gate was incredibly rude. I drove up to pick up a patient, but he just waved me to the back gate. I rolled down my window and explained that I was just picking up my mother and asked if I could wait a moment.

His response was, "Then go to the back. How can you pick anyone up at the front? The front gate isn't open!" He also made a very unpleasant face. Everyone in the car was stunned.

This was our first time here, and he doesn't work here every day. Couldn't he have explained it more politely? He should change his security guards; this kind of behavior is not pleasant for customers.
